mechanism: Nafcillin induces CYP450 enzymes and increases renal clearance, potentially reducing vancomycin levels; concurrent use increases nephrotoxicity risk and may reduce vancomycin efficacy.
action: Monitor vancomycin serum levels (target trough 15-20 mcg/mL), renal function, and urinalysis regularly; adjust vancomycin dosing based on therapeutic drug monitoring and renal clearance.
